title: Missing bypass navigation
user_impact: Keyboard users must tab through the navigation on every page change.
technical_impact: Missing skip link, missing HTML5 landmarks.
source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks; ACT cf77f2 (Bypass Blocks of Repeated Content); G1, H69, ARIA11
expectation:
SC 2.4.1 is met by any one of headings (H69), a main landmark (ARIA11) or a
skip link (G1). Fails when none of the three exists and the page marks up a
navigation or banner block, the blocks Understanding 2.4.1 names as repeated.
Without such a block, whether anything repeats across pages cannot be told
from one document: review. While a modal dialog is open, the mechanisms are
missing for the moment of measurement: review. role="heading" and role="main"
count like native ones, also inside open shadow roots; a hidden heading
(hidden attribute) bypasses nothing. One finding at the html element.
